description.value:
You ward a door, a window, or an area no larger than a 20-foot cube against intrusion. Until the power ends, you are alerted whenever a Tiny or larger creature touches or enters the warded area, unless you designated that creature as exempt when you cast the power.

You choose whether the alert is mental or audible. A mental alert pings your mind, waking you if asleep, as long as you remain within 1 mile of the area. An audible alert rings like a hand bell, audible within 60 feet, for 10 seconds. The ward lasts until the end of your next short or long rest, whichever comes first.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 1
